set.body:
Outcome

Ensure the migration cannot recreate FoldPlan under another name.

Acceptance

- New compilers accept only purpose-specific bound designs.
- Every legacy FoldPlan call site is assigned to validation, cross-fit, pairing, randomization, or deletion.
- No compatibility wrapper returns or stores FoldPlan.
- Final source removal is linked to the Phase 6 deletion ticket.
set.title: P3.7: prohibit FoldPlan in new paths and record its final deletion map
